From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SecureEdge private deployment: connectivity validation & on-prem checklist

Marcus / Naomi —

Quick technical notes ahead of the call so we can prioritize agenda items: 

- Recommendation: Use VPC peering for low-latency control plane and private endpoints for the management/control APIs. Reserve a separate /28 for control plane endpoints to avoid accidental overlaps.
- BGP vs static routes: BGP preferred if you want automatic path failover. If you prefer static, we'll need the exact route map and maintenance window for updates.
- MTU: set border MTU to 9001 if your network supports jumbo frames (helps with large model artifacts).
- Ports: allow 443 for control plane, 50050 for internal gRPC, and TCP 10250 for Kubernetes node health checks (if you run the on-prem appliance in a k8s cluster).

Attaching a short prep excerpt (redwood-vpc-peering-prep.txt) with our peering checklist.

If Tara can share the firewall matrix details and the installer contact, we'll add those to the pre-call doc and confirm a runbook for the install day.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 13 Jan 2028 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SecureEdge private deployment: connectivity validation & on-prem checklist

Adding a couple of ops-level constraints for the install runbook: 

- If on-prem is air-gapped: bring a burnable USB with the appliance image and verify SHA256 sums ahead of time.
- HSM note: if you want local HSM, we need the vendor model and serial; some vendors require a firmware compatibility check with our agent.
- Firewall specifics: allow outbound DNS (53 UDP), NTP (123 UDP), and our telemetry endpoint to 10.100.200.0/24 only.
- Rollback plan: confirm snapshot cadence for the appliance and a restore window (we recommend 30m RTO for initial cutover).

I'll be on the call Thu 01/12 10:00 PST as listed — happy to walk through the port matrix.

-Karthik
Infrastructure SRE, Redwood Inference
